source_text: De puteo et cantico eius. Lectio putei et cantici quod apud puteum cecinit Israel redundat mysteriis. Hic est puteus quem dixit Dominus: congrega populum et dabo eis aquam bibere.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning well and song its. Reading of-well and of-song which at well sang Israel overflows with-mysteries. This is well which said Lord: gather people and I-will-give to-them water to-drink.
pass_b_english: On the well and its song: the reading of the well where Israel sang overflows with mysteries. [[This is the well of which the Lord said to Moses, Gather the people, and I will give them water to drink >> Bible:Numbers 21:16-17]].
